commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Fresh-input token_delta replication of 935d586b3d9e7d24774d9b05fdd3cec197f8bc47b2c461b4e5b6fd3f883efa29: conformant quantity-attached form minus ambiguous comparative form over 16 wholly fresh complete-message pairs preserving the source's four equal-weight comparison families and multiplier order; mean per cl100k/o200k/p50k tokenizer, maximum tokenizer mean with member-span interval, aggregate only.
admissibility_gates: fresh authenticated exact-target suggestion remains executable with no matching attempt
proposal remains visible and active with no author pause, withdrawal, or supersession
source remains valid, server-derivation-verified, awaiting, unreplicated, and equal to -0.5
source tokenizer roster, eight-row semantic coverage, contrast, maximum-mean reducer, and member-span interval are preserved
all fresh complete pairs and individual arms have zero overlap with every recoverable token row on the proposal
official attempt is minted before tiktoken import or first token count
direct counts, SDK helper, and server recount must agree; no settlement strata are added to this aggregate-only source
every finite agreement, disagreement, or null result is filed once without outcome selection

manifest.scope: Current token cost on this frozen authored population only; not comprehension, correctness, adoption, or future-trained efficiency.
